description:
Turn ACTION: lines in notes and logs into TASK: anchors, then list or change those tasks where they sit in their source files.

Usage: bare `tasks` with no subcommand runs ingest.

Subcommands:
  ingest [--dry-run] [--quiet] — rewrite every ACTION: line in thread notes/logs to a TASK: anchor with a new 8-char uuid
  add THREAD TEXT [--due D] [--scheduled D] [--priority P] [--depends UUID] — append an ACTION to buffer.md (same as `buffer add-action`)
  done UUID — change TASK to DONE and stamp end with today's date
  drop UUID — change TASK to DROPPED (abandoned) and stamp end; prints open tasks that still depend on it (they are not changed)
  set-description UUID TEXT — rewrite the task body
  set-assignee UUID PERSON — rewrite the (Assignee) prefix
  set-due UUID DATE — set the due date
  set-scheduled UUID DATE — set the scheduled date
  set-priority UUID PRIORITY — set the priority: H, M or L
  add-depends UUID DEP_UUID — make UUID wait on DEP_UUID
  rm-depends UUID DEP_UUID — remove a dependency
  list [--priority P] [--thread T] [--assignee A] [--overdue] [--json] — pending tasks grouped by thread A-Z, then priority/due/entry
  next — top 5 pending tasks by priority, due, entry
  show UUID — detail view of one task

Args:
  UUID, DEP_UUID  8-char task uuid from `tasks list`; any unique prefix works
  THREAD          'Kind/Name', e.g. Projects/Northwind
  TEXT (add)      '(Assignee) description' or 'description'; the assignee needs a file at people/<Name>.md
  PERSON          name with a file at people/<Name>.md; a leading people/ is allowed
  DATE            YYYY-MM-DD

Flags:
  ingest (also accepted before any subcommand, i.e. bare `tasks`):
    --dry-run          show what would be ingested; write nothing
    --quiet            suppress per-action output
  add:
    --due YYYY-MM-DD
    --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD
    --priority H|M|L
    --depends UUID8    repeatable
  list:
    --priority H|M|L   only this priority
    --thread Kind/Name only tasks whose source note carries this thread
    --assignee PERSON  only this assignee
    --overdue          only tasks whose due date is before today
    --json             JSON output

Examples:
  ["add", "Projects/Northwind", "(Sam Rivera) Send quarterly report", "--due", "2026-06-15", "--priority", "H"]
  ["list", "--thread", "Projects/Northwind", "--json"]
  ["done", "abcd1234"]
  ["set-due", "abcd1234", "2026-06-15"]

Notes:
  `add` only queues the task in the buffer. It gets a uuid on the next `buffer flush`, which also ingests it, so you do not need to run `tasks` afterwards.
  ingest, done, drop, set-*, add-depends and rm-depends rewrite note and log files in place. Never edit TASK/DONE/DROPPED lines by hand.
  Exit 1 means one of: no task matches the uuid prefix, an empty prefix, a date not in YYYY-MM-DD, an empty description, a person who does not resolve to people/<Name>.md, or a task set to depend on itself.
